titleEnglish: Derman Arardım Derdime — I Sought a Cure for My Ailment
note: By Niyazi Mısrî (17th c.). A classic of Sufi realization: the cure, the proof, and the Beloved were within all along.

verses.ar:
Derman arardım derdime
Derdim bana derman imiş
Bürhan sorardım aslıma
Aslım bana bürhan imiş
verses.en: I sought a cure for my ailment — my ailment itself was my cure. I sought a proof of my origin — my origin itself was my proof.

verses.ar:
Sağ u solum gözler idim
Dost yüzünü görsem deyu
Ben taşrada arar idim
Ol can içinde can imiş
verses.en: I searched to my right and left, longing to see the Friend's face; I was seeking outside, yet He was the very soul within the soul.

verses.ar:
Öyle sanırdım ayriyem
Dost gayridir ben gayriyem
Benden görüp işiteni
Bildim ki ol cânân imiş
verses.en: I used to think I was apart — that the Friend was other and I was other; then I knew that the One who sees and hears through me is the Beloved.

verses.ar:
Savm u salât u hac ile
Sanma biter zâhid işin
İnsan-ı kâmil olmaya
Lâzım olan irfan imiş
verses.en: Do not imagine, O ascetic, that your work is finished with fasting, prayer, and pilgrimage; what is needed to become a perfected human being is inner gnosis.

verses.ar:
Mürşid gerektir bildire
Hakk'ı sana Hakka'l-yakîn
Mürşidi olmayanların
Bildikleri gümân imiş
verses.en: A guide is needed to make you know the Truth with the certainty of direct knowledge; what those without a guide know is mere conjecture.

verses.ar:
Anla hemen bir sözdürür
Yokuş değildir düzdürür
Âlem kamu bir yüzdürür
Gören anı hayran imiş
verses.en: Understand at once: it is a single word, no steep climb but level ground; all the world is one single face — whoever sees it is lost in wonder.

verses.ar:
İşit Niyazi'nin sözün
Bir nesne örtmez Hak yüzün
Hak'tan ayan bir nesne yok
Gözsüzlere pinhan imiş
verses.en: Hear the word of Niyazi: nothing veils the face of the Truth; nothing is more manifest than the Truth — yet to the sightless it stays hidden.
